subject.title: fix(feishu): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should the existing configured Feishu HTTP timeout also define the post-header chunk-idle deadline and forcibly close a stalled inbound media stream?
rationale: The implementation is correct for the demonstrated hang, but it deliberately broadens an existing user setting’s semantics and establishes source destruction as the SDK cleanup policy.

options.title: Adopt the configured idle deadline
options.body: Land the current behavior so the existing Feishu timeout consistently bounds both request setup and stalled response-body progress.

options.title: Use a fixed internal idle deadline
options.body: Keep the hang protection but decouple post-header inactivity from user-configured HTTP timeout values.

options.title: Pause for live tenant proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a real Feishu tenant confirms the SDK stream’s teardown behavior under an actual stalled download.

recommendation.title: Adopt the configured idle deadline
recommendation.body: Land the current behavior so the existing Feishu timeout consistently bounds both request setup and stalled response-body progress.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the surrounding Feishu inbound-media behavior and makes them the strongest history-based owner for its timeout policy.
